_comment: Default 3-region partition of the usa topology. In Phase 1 federated training each section runs as its own ns-3 process (cross-section links dropped — see FilterTopoSpecBySection). In Phase 2 'fullrun' demo a single ns-3 process spawns M Local Controllers, each owning its section's switches, with the full backbone (including inter-section links) physically present; inter_domain_routes below are then pre-installed as static border-switch flow-mods (Option A). All indices are 0-based and reference scratch/scenarios/usa/main.cc BuildUsaSpec(); DPID = index + 1.
_inter_domain_routes_doc: Static per-domain routes for Phase 2. Each entry says 'when in section from_section, packets destined for hosts in to_section should exit through via_switch out the port that connects to next_switch'. via_switch must be in from_section's border_switches; next_switch must be in to_section. Transitive routes (e.g. 0->2 via central) reuse the next-hop section's border. All indices are 0-based switch indices in the full USA topology.
